title: Support & Help
description: Email the Puzzled support team about your account, games, subscription or data. A person replies, usually within 24-48 hours.

faq.title: Questions this page can answer
faq.subtitle: Written from how the product actually behaves. Anything the product cannot decide, email support.

signIn.question: I cannot get back into my account. What now?
signIn.answer: Sign in with the email and password you registered with, or with the same provider button if you created the account that way. If the password is gone, choose 'Forgot password?' next to the password field on the sign-in page: a reset link is emailed to your address, and you set a new password from it.

guest.question: I played as a guest — is that progress saved?
guest.answer: A guest finish counts for the day you played, and the free daily puzzle never needs an account. The result is stored against a guest id in that browser, not against an account, so it does not follow you to another device and it is not carried into an account if you sign in later. A signed-in account is what keeps the streak, results and stats across devices.

cancel.question: How do I cancel Premium?
cancel.answer: Sign in, open Settings → Subscription and use 'Manage Subscription'. You can cancel any time, and the free daily puzzle keeps working either way.

afterCancel.question: What happens after I cancel?
afterCancel.answer: Premium continues until the end of the period you already paid for, then the account returns to the free tier: the daily free puzzle stays, the rest of the suite locks. Premium access is decided by the server each time it is checked, not stored in the app, so what you see follows the billing state.

refunds.question: Can I get a refund?
refunds.answer: Refund requests go through the support inbox: write to {email} from the address on your account and include the purchase date. The Terms of Service describe refunds as at our discretion within 7 days of purchase.

dayStart.question: When does a new puzzle day start?
dayStart.answer: Everything runs on Hong Kong time (UTC+8, no daylight saving): a new daily set appears at midnight, and every player gets the same set for that day. Results and streaks use that same clock.

streak.question: Why did my streak end?
streak.answer: A streak day means finishing at least one qualifying puzzle in a product day. Finish none and the current streak ends — your best streak and past results stay. Premium includes streak freezes: an available freeze can cover a missed day, and with auto-freeze turned on one is used for you.

accessibility.question: Is Puzzled accessible?
accessibility.answer: Support varies by module, and the honest picture matters more than a slogan. In place today: a skip-to-content link on the main site; labels on the icon-only controls in the games; live regions that announce status and results in several modules; visible keyboard focus outlines; and custom animation switched off when your system asks for reduced motion. Known gap: some in-game control labels are still English only, whatever interface language you pick. If a module blocks you, email support with the module name and what happened, so the team can look at that case.

data.question: How do I get a copy of my data, or delete it?
data.answer: Write to {email} for access, an export, correction or deletion; the privacy inbox handles those requests. The Privacy Policy lists what is collected, which third parties are involved and the rights you can exercise.
